title: Indian men are so disgusting....
description:
Checkout Odoo Sign -- https://www.odoo.com/r/8ap

From people trying to use AI tools like Grok to digitally undress women, to the Gwalior wall-painting incident, to the global embarrassment of the “bob vegene” stereotype—India is once again being dragged into the spotlight for the worst reasons.

This video is not about attacking all Indian men. It’s about calling out a growing culture of online sexual harassment, objectification, and entitlement that a section of Indian users openly displays—on social media, in comments, through AI misuse, and even in public spaces.

Where is this mindset coming from? Why is women’s dignity treated like content? And how is this damaging India’s image, society, and the next generation?

In this video, we confront an uncomfortable truth many prefer to ignore.
